items.title: Colossal Biosciences announces new AI platform to help accelerate de-extinction efforts
items.summary: Colossal announced a new AI platform to help accelerate its de-extinction efforts and  Peter Diamandis has launched a new fund to back startups who use it.
items.creator: Dominic-Madori Davis

items.title: Flock CEO: We haven’t ‘fired’ any police departments as customers
items.summary: Flock CEO Garrett Langley said that the surveillance company has not canceled contracts of any police department or law enforcement agency, despite reports of abuse.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker, Amanda Silberling, Rebecca Bellan

items.title: Electric vehicle sales in the US are showing signs of life
items.summary: The electric vehicle market in the U.S. has been growing for the last three consecutive quarters.
items.creator: Tim De Chant
